ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a topographic profile along the tropic line. Both the left side and the right side are sea areas; the sea area on the left is labeled e, and the sea area on the right is labeled f. The left edge of the land part is adjacent to a very high, steep mountain peak body, with b labeled near the peak top; c is labeled at a lower place in the middle; on the right side there is also a lower highland or mountain labeled d. Below the profile, longitude labels such as 70°, 60°, and 50° can be seen. Overall, it shows high mountains on the west side, with the terrain lowering eastward and reaching the coast on the other side. Reasoning: This kind of profile along the tropic line with "high mountains near the sea on the west side, longitudes about 70°—50°" corresponds to the topographic profile of South America along the Tropic of Capricorn. The sea area e on the left is located on the west coast of South America and is a Pacific Ocean sea area; affected by the Peru Cold Current, the seawater temperature is relatively low. The sea area f on the right is located on the east coast of South America and is an Atlantic Ocean sea area; affected by the Brazil Warm Current, the seawater temperature is relatively high. Therefore, the temperature of sea area e is lower than the temperature of sea area f.

<image1>

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：e 位于剖面最左侧海域，f 位于最右侧海域，陆地左侧紧邻高大山脉、右侧为较低高地，并有 70°、60°、50°经度标注。再据此判断该剖面是南美洲沿南回归线的地形剖面，e 为西岸太平洋海域，f 为东岸大西洋海域。调用洋流知识：西岸受秘鲁寒流降温，东岸受巴西暖流增温，所以 Te<Tf。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是沿回归线的地形剖面，左侧和右侧都是海域，左侧海域标注为 e，右侧海域标注为 f；陆地部分左缘紧邻一个很高、陡峭的山地峰体，峰顶附近标注 b，中部较低处标注 c，右侧还有较低的高地或山地标注 d。剖面下方可见 70°、60°、50°等经度标注，整体表现为西侧高大山脉、向东地势降低并到达另一侧海岸。推理：这种“西侧近海有高大山脉、经度约 70°—50°”的沿回归线剖面对应南美洲沿南回归线的地形剖面。左侧 e 海域位于南美洲西岸，为太平洋海域，受秘鲁寒流影响，海水温度偏低；右侧 f 海域位于南美洲东岸，为大西洋海域，受巴西暖流影响，海水温度偏高。因此 e 海域温度低于 f 海域温度。
